commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb devices -l; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d ''); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) echo 'Unexpected Android device model' >&2; exit 20;; esac

set -euo pipefail; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; echo APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'); if command -v apkanalyzer >/dev/null 2>&1; then test "$(apkanalyzer manifest application-id "$APK")" = 'io.blueeye'; elif command -v aapt >/dev/null 2>&1; then aapt dump badging "$APK" | head -n 1 | grep -q "package: name='io.blueeye'"; fi

set -euo pipefail; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb install -r "$APK"; adb shell pm path io.blueeye | grep -q '^package:'; adb shell dumpsys package io.blueeye | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=' | head -n 2; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-monkey.txt 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/tracker-monkey.txt; exit 30; }; sleep 2; adb shell pidof io.blueeye | grep -q '[0-9]'; echo ACCEPTED_APK_INSTALL_PASS; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
